review_type: Independent analytic source review, not proof-assistant verification and not finite numerical testing
scope: R09 analytic arbitrary-dimensional local tensor-product five-outcome POVM bridge

checks.same_fixed_embedding_for_both_settings: PASS: K=H direct_sum M, J h=(h,0) is independent of x; V_x and W_x may vary with x
checks.isometry_and_defect: PASS: V_x*V_x=I from bounded positive square roots and finite POVM sum; D_x=I-V_x V_x* is orthogonal projection; D_x V_x=0
checks.unitary_completion: PASS: W_x(h,k)=(V_x h+D_x k,V_x* k); W_x*(l,g)=(V_x*l,D_x l+V_x g); W_x*W_x=I and W_x W_x*=I by V_x*V_x=I, D_x V_x=0, D_x^2=D_x
checks.complete_five_outcome_pvm: PASS: Q_a direct_sum delta_a0 I_H are orthogonal complete PVM on M direct_sum H; conjugation by W_x gives PVM on fixed K; omitted extra summand would fail completeness
checks.effect_compression: PASS: W_x J h=(V_x h,0), so J*P_a|x J=V_x* Q_a V_x=E_a|x for both settings
checks.separate_complements: PASS: identifying each dilation H direct_sum K_x and putting both into H direct_sum K_0 direct_sum K_1, extending unused components by outcome 0, uses same original-H inclusion
checks.joint_tensor_compression: PASS: (J_A tensor J_B)*(P_A tensor P_B)(J_A tensor J_B)=E_A tensor E_B for every outcome/setting; no same-party product factorization invoked
checks.states: PASS: single enlarged density operator or positive functional phi_tilde(T)=phi(J_AB* T J_AB) is positive normalized and preserves all joint probabilities; no state depends on setting
checks.arbitrary_spaces: PASS: construction uses finite direct sums, bounded positive square roots, isometries and tensor products valid at any Hilbert dimension including nonseparable; no complement-cardinality identification or finite approximation assumed
checks.scope_boundary: PASS: tensor-product local POVM theorem, bounded cross-party commuting PVM identity; no abstract commuting-POVM dilation claim

limitations: Analytic review does not constitute Lean/formal verification, human peer review or infallibility proof.
Finite R09 diagnostics supplement this argument and do not establish universal quantifiers.
Final manuscript must express the same construction and scope; manuscript review is separate.
